prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If the object is approached, then grab it, process it, and move to destination. If not, approach or scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObject
		DO MoveToDestination
	END
